<tool_call>
<function=generate_email>
<parameter=subject>
Exceptional Service at [Hotel Name]
</parameter>
<parameter=body>
Dear [Hotel Manager's Name],

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to express my sincere appreciation for the exceptional service I received during my recent stay at [Hotel Name].

From the moment I arrived, the staff went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction. In particular, I would like to highlight the outstanding contributions of [Employee Name 1] and [Employee Name 2]. Their attentiveness, professionalism, and warm hospitality truly made my stay memorable.

The quality of service at your hotel is a testament to your team's dedication and commitment to excellence. I have no doubt that this level of care is what keeps guests returning and recommending your establishment to others.

I will certainly be recommending [Hotel Name] to my peers and colleagues, as I believe they would greatly appreciate the same level of service and attention to detail that I experienced.

Thank you once again for making my stay so pleasant. I look forward to the opportunity to return in the future.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Contact Information]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
